confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied city context, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Andalusian coastal cities with similar tourism demand and summer pricing, using a EUR/USD conversion of roughly 1.15 for the USD anchors. Cocktail and wine_glass were not priced from direct knowledge alone; they follow the local beer-to-drink relationship, with cocktails about 3-4x beer and wine about 1.3x beer.
